title: Pure Galaxy-Photon
summary: Galaxy-Photon unites Kite Tenjo's Level 4 and Level 8 LIGHT engine to field devastating Rank 4 and Rank 8 Xyz bosses. Photon Delta Wing sets up the essential Rank 4 Galaxy Photon Dragon, which mills Photon Emperor or searches Galaxy Hundred to climb into Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord for monster negation and Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy for Spell disruption, backed by the raw OTK power of Number 62 and Number C62.

allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 LIGHT Dragon Xyz summoned via two Level 8 Galaxy/Photon monsters that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Photon Jumper, Photon Vanisher, or Photon Thrasher.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Photon Emperor (for an instant Level 8 body) or Photon Jumper (to search any Galaxy/Photon Spell/Trap) to the GY.

main: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon
Core Level 8 LIGHT Dragon required in hand, Deck, and GY for Photon Vanisher, Galaxy Trance, and Number 90's full detach effects.
Galaxy-Eyes Afterglow Dragon
Special Summons itself while you control a Galaxy-Eyes monster, and when detached as Xyz Material, summons Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon and doubles all Number Xyz ATK.
Galaxy Soldier
Sends 1 LIGHT monster from hand to GY (triggering Photon Jumper or Photon Emperor) to Special Summon itself and searches another Galaxy monster.
Photon Emperor
Level 8 LIGHT Warrior that Special Summons itself when sent to the GY (except from field) while you control a Photon/Galaxy monster, and grants an extra LIGHT Normal Summon.
Galaxy Summoner
Revives a Photon or Galaxy monster from the GY in Defense Position on Normal/Special Summon and changes another LIGHT monster's Level to 4.
Galaxy Wizard
Increases its Level by 4 to become Level 8, or tributes itself to search any Galaxy card from the Deck.
Photon Jumper
Searches any Photon or Galaxy Spell/Trap when sent to the GY, and can Special Summon itself to end the Battle Phase when an opponent attacks.
Photon Vanisher
Special Summons itself while you control a Photon or Galaxy monster and searches Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon from the Deck.
Photon Delta Wing
Summons a second Photon Delta Wing from the hand or Deck on Normal Summon for a 1-card Rank 4 Galaxy Photon Dragon (locking you to LIGHT monsters).
Photon Orbital
Equips itself from hand/field to a Photon or Galaxy monster and sends itself to the GY to search any Photon or Galaxy monster.
Galaxy Hundred
Continuous Spell that sends any Photon or Galaxy monster from Deck to GY on activation, and steals or banishes a monster from the opponent's Extra Deck when Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon is summoned.
Galaxy Expedition
Special Summons a Level 5 or higher Photon or Galaxy monster from the Deck while you control a Level 5+ Photon or Galaxy.
Galaxy Trance
Pays 2000 LP to revive a Photon monster from the GY and Special Summon a Galaxy monster with the same Level from the Deck.
Photon Sanctuary
Summons 2 LIGHT Thunder Photon Tokens (2000 ATK) to immediately Link Summon Galaxy-Eyes Solflare Dragon.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Photon Jumper or Photon Vanisher.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: dumps Photon Emperor or Photon Jumper.
extra: Galaxy Photon Dragon
Rank 4 Xyz that detaches 1 material to search or dump any Photon/Galaxy card, boosts LIGHT monsters by 500 ATK, and changes summoned LIGHT monsters to Level 4 or 8.
Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord
Rank 8 Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate an opponent's monster effect (and destroys it if detaching a Galaxy card), and searches/attaches a Photon or Galaxy card.
Number 62: Galaxy-Eyes Prime Photon Dragon
Rank 8 OTK boss that gains 200 ATK per Rank on the field and reaches 11,200+ ATK when detaching Galaxy-Eyes Afterglow Dragon.
Number C62: Neo Galaxy-Eyes Prime Photon Dragon
Ranks up over Number 62 to attack up to 3 times on monsters while unaffected by opponent's monster effects.
Galaxy-Eyes Full Armor Photon Dragon
Rank 8 Xyz that stacks over any Galaxy-Eyes Xyz to detach 1 material and destroy a face-up card.
Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Dragon
Rank 8 Xyz that detaches 1 material to steal an opponent's monster (which can then be ranked up into Full Armor or Cipher Blade).
Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Blade Dragon
Rank 9 Xyz that stacks over Cipher or Full Armor to detach 1 material and destroy any card on the field.
Starliege Photon Blast Dragon
Rank 4 Xyz that Special Summons a Photon monster from hand and makes your 2000+ ATK monsters untargetable and indestructible by effects.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Xyz that negates Spell activations and attaches them as Xyz Material.
Galaxy-Eyes Solflare Dragon

Link-2 LIGHT Dragon that recovers a Photon/Galaxy monster from the GY on Link Summon and discards 1 Photon/Galaxy card (or Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon) as a Quick Effect to destroy an opponent's Special Summoned monster.
